announcement: This release hardens security: the cPanel import now validates archive members before extraction, and it ships alongside encrypted-at-rest database passwords, hashed FTP/SSH credentials, proxy-secret IP trust, and login timing and webhook-replay defenses. It adds full Turkish/English localization across the panel with a per-user and server-default language, reseller multi-user accounts with disk and traffic quotas, cPanel full-account import, S3/B2 remote backups, and spam filtering. Many fixes are also included; updating is recommended.
